title: Restriction of matrix rows
statement: For a real matrix $A$ indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a subset $B$ of those indices, the restricted matrix has entry $A_{ij}$ when its row index $i$ belongs to $B$, and entry $0$ otherwise.
